scope: Previously observed SPH is used only for exploratory V4.6 development/adaptation; this is not an independent or confirmatory test.

partition.outer_assignment: SHA-256(namespace + seed + patient ID); first 64 digest bits modulo 5
partition.inner_assignment: SHA-256(namespace + seed + patient ID); first 64 digest bits modulo 4; bucket 3 is threshold-tune, buckets 0-2 are calibration-fit

method.name: positive-slope Platt scaling
method.input: frozen V4.5 class probability, clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6] and transformed to logit
method.fit: unweighted record-level binary log loss on calibration-fit patients
method.isotonic_or_temperature_variants: not run in this preregistered B1 experiment

threshold_selection.objective: maximize endpoint F1 on the disjoint threshold-tune patients
threshold_selection.grid: all distinct probabilities in the threshold-tune subset plus a no-positive-prediction sentinel

endpoints.name: ASMI
endpoints.reference: Anteroseptal MI ECG statement; not acute or clinically adjudicated MI

endpoints.name: IMI
endpoints.reference: Inferior MI ECG statement; not acute or clinically adjudicated MI

endpoints.name: LVH
endpoints.reference: LVH ECG statement; not imaging-confirmed hypertrophy

endpoints.name: PAC
endpoints.reference: Atrial premature-complex ECG statement; not beat-level event detection

endpoints.name: PVC
endpoints.reference: Ventricular premature-complex ECG statement; not beat-level event detection

endpoints.name: RBBB
endpoints.reference: Complete RBBB ECG statement; code 105 is not pooled

metrics.baseline_decisions: saved V4.5 output labels, including the existing P8 fallback where applicable
metrics.thresholded_oof_decisions: nested-fold F1 thresholds selected without outer-evaluation labels

bootstrap.unit: patient cluster; repeated ECGs sampled together
bootstrap.method: paired unstratified percentile bootstrap on out-of-fold predictions
bootstrap.scope_limit: conditional on the fitted cross-fold calibrators; calibrators are not refit inside bootstrap replicates

privacy.aggregate_receipt_mode: 0600 in CEDIA until sanitized aggregate is copied into the repository
